data.content_ref: inline:Add a residue operator on the fixed point: for each suspended node, compute the set of accepted attackers and the set of accepted defenders; define a secondary extension that accepts exactly those suspended nodes whose attacker set is empty and defender set is nonempty, but do not commit this secondary extension to the root-validity guarantee. Emit it as a distinct probationary label so downstream reasoners can use it heuristically without treating it as grounded. This strengthens usable output without weakening the committed fixed point, but risks label confusion unless the marker is type-enforced.
